newsitem.title: USA: Advanced Tissue up on Dermagraft, upgrade.
newsitem.headline: Advanced Tissue up on Dermagraft, upgrade.

text.p: Shares in Advanced Tissue Sciences Inc rose strongly in morning trade on Monday boosted by news about its Dermagraft product and a rating upgrade, traders said.
"That seems to be the reason it is moving," one trader said.
The company's stock rose 2-3/8 points on the Nasdaq to a year's high of 19-7/8 at midday. Volume was 2.8 million shares.

The company said in a statement it planned to submit a Premarket Approval application for its Dermagraft product to the Food and Drug Administration in December. Dermagraft is used to treat diabetic foot ulcers.
Morgan Stanley said it upgraded Advanced Tissue to strong buy from outperform. Further details were not immediately available.
